violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed food employee put on gloves without washing his hands first. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Multiple wiping cloths, wet, were found on prep counters. Wiping cloths should be stored in a sanitizing solution or laundered.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. Testing strips were not available for testing sanitizing solution strength. Test strips should be available to assure proper sanitizing is done.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with waste receptacle as needed. Garbage receptacle not available at hand washing sink. Garbage receptacle should be available for disposing paper towels.
